name: com.parkyn.bounded-buoyancy
description: Floating done properly, in one component: put Bounded Buoyancy Body on a Rigidbody, set a density, and it floats at the right depth, tilts and rights itself, rides the waves and never shoots out of the water (the added mass of the water it displaces goes into its inertia every physics step). Then, as you want them: water with waves, currents and splashes, or HDRP's Water System; real water and air whose density follows temperature, salt and depth, with layers; boats with keels, rudders, sails and propellers; compartments that flood through holes so ships list and sink; cannons; fishing lines, floats and fish; and a 2D version.

samples.description: Nine 3D scenes (release, float, tilt, waves, sky, many, river, wind, boats) and a 2D scene, built in code. After importing, use Tools > Bounded Buoyancy > Play 3D Demo (or Play 2D Demo).
